newsitem.title: MEXICO: ING Barings hires Boni as chief of Mexico research.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings hires Boni as chief of Mexico research.

text.p: ING Barings said Tuesday it had hired Mexican analyst Felix Boni as head of research at ING Baring Grupo Financiero (Mexico).
Boni, with 10 years experience in Mexican equity research, joins ING Barings from HSBC James Capel, where he was head of Mexican research, ING Barings said in a press release.
Boni, who has a Ph.D. in political science from the University of Pittsburgh, previously served from 1990 to 1995 as director of research at the Interacciones brokerage house.
